# ogv.js 1.9.0 / VP9

The JavaScript and WebAssembly decoder are unmodified single-threaded, non-SIMD files from the `dist/` directory of the [ogv 1.9.0 npm distribution](https://registry.npmjs.org/ogv/-/ogv-1.9.0.tgz). The [corresponding source](https://github.com/bvibber/ogv.js/tree/1.9.0) includes the wrapper, libvpx submodule, and build configuration. This directory includes upstream notices for the MIT-licensed wrapper, BSD-licensed libvpx, WebM patent grant, and Emscripten 3.1.57 runtime with musl libc. The libvpx source is pinned in ogv.js at commit `f473cd46fa57d029c284cde32da21d171422d838`.
